consequence.statement: A read-only status subresource (status.bindings[] with conditions) was added to the ScrapeConfig schema. The operator only updates it when the "StatusForConfigurationResources" feature gate is enabled, so existing ScrapeConfig resources need no operator action.

assertion.statement: Between 0.85.0 and 0.86.2, the monitoring.coreos.com/v1alpha1 ScrapeConfig CRD gains a read-only status field (status.bindings[] with conditions). The operator only fills it in when the StatusForConfigurationResources feature gate is enabled.
